narrative.overview: The station library is calm and easy to scan. Existing genre sleeves provide the rich colour and texture. The interface uses neutral tonal layers, strong headings, and deliberate separation between sections. Android controls, system Back and touch conventions remain familiar.
keyCharacteristics: Existing square artwork, contained and decoded at its display size.
Magenta-derived functional accents on neutral light and dark surfaces.
Lazy shelves, readable rows and quick search.

rules.name: The Content Colour Rule
rules.body: Genre artwork keeps its original colours. UI accent appears on primary playback, selection, focus and connection status. Favourite hearts use onSurface in both saved and unsaved states.

rules.name: The Recoverable Station Rule
rules.body: An unavailable station receives a compact neutral message with Retry and a calm inline player state. Error colours remain available for actual errors.

rules.name: The Full Name Rule
rules.body: Rows allow two lines and the expanded player allows three. Truncation preserves accessible names. Text scaling is never clamped; short screens can scroll the player.

dos: Do use semantic theme roles and preserve Android system media/notification controls.
Do keep lazy builders, pagination, keyed items, bounded image decoding and the existing disk cache.
Do verify native rendering, larger text and performance on real hardware before sign-off.
donts: Don't crop genre artwork, tint it, zoom it, or decode every group at startup.
Don't use red hearts or alarming offline banners.
Don't add decorative perpetual motion, list-wide entrance staggering, blur or shadows to scrolling items.
